Name: Veronnica's SVE Portraits
Author: Veronnica0504
Description:
[color=#ea9999][size=5][b]MOD介绍：[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]这是我为1.6版本绘制的SVE角色肖像美化包，包含6位可婚角色和桑迪、马龙。其余人物会在我完成原版村民之后更新。[/size]
[color=#e06666][size=3]感谢♥：[/size][/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]非常非常开心[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/187053765]Lihang233[/url]老师愿意帮助我编写和修改CP格式的代码，感激之情无以言表，会化为动力加速创作。[/size][/color]

[size=5][b][color=#ea9999]安装方法：[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3]1.[size=3]需要前置MOD：[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 和 [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE大型拓展[/url]﻿。
2.解压后将 [u][CP]Veronnica's SVE Portraits[/u] 文件夹放入 [u][u]Stardew Valley\Mods[/u][/u] 即可。

[/size][b][b][size=3][color=#9fc5e8]--------------------------♥-----[/color][color=#9fc5e8]---------------------[/color][/size][/b][/b]

[color=#ea9999][size=5][b]About this MOD:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]These are the SVE character portraits I drew for version 1.6, contains 6 marriageable characters, Sandy and Marlon. The rest of the characters will be updated after I finish the vanilla villagers.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][color=#ea9999][size=5][b]How to install:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.Requires: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].﻿
2.Put [u][CP]Veronnica's SVE Portraitss[/u] folder into [u][u]Stardew Valley\Mods[/u][/u] .
[/size]

Update 1.0.2: Fix the problem that Marlon's portrait cannot be displayed outdoors; Updated code (make sure you download the latest version of SVE).

This is a version that requires manual replacement of images, because I cannot ensure the availability of the CP version. Please unzip and put it in Mods>Stardew Valley Expanded>[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded, and replace the "assets' folder.
